title: Mobile app promotion page
when: The user wants a page that promotes a mobile app and sends people to download it.
prompt:
Goal: Show the app in action and make downloading obvious on the visitor own device.
Steps:
1. Hero with the promise, a screenshot in a device frame drawn with CSS, and download buttons with text labels.
2. Three to five features, each with a screenshot and a one line benefit.
3. How it works in three numbered steps.
4. Short testimonials only if the user gave them; ratings never invented.
5. Final download block and a support link.
Quality bar:
- Screenshots have descriptive alt text.
- Download buttons name the platform in text.
- Fast on mobile.
Pitfalls:
- Official store badge images the user did not provide.
- Fake ratings.
- Heavy video backgrounds.
Verify:
- [ ] Download links have clear text.
- [ ] Images lazy load after the hero.
- [ ] One h1.
- [ ] Works at 375 px.
Output: index.html and style.css.

examples.input: página para divulgar meu app de hábitos
examples.output: hero with screenshot, 4 features, 3 steps, download links with platform names
